listeningQuestions.audio: A true friend stays with you when times are hard.
opts: 真正的朋友会在困难时陪着你。
真正的朋友只在好时光出现。
真正的朋友住得离你很近。
真正的朋友总是很有趣。

listeningQuestions.audio: He gave me a grateful smile after I helped him.
opts: 我帮了他之后,他向我露出感激的微笑。
我帮了他之后,他生气地走开了。
我们一起对老师笑了笑。

listeningQuestions.audio: With one small gesture you can change a person's life.
opts: 一个小小的举动就能改变一个人的一生。
一句大话也救不了一个人。
改变别人需要花很多钱。
一个手势没有任何意义。

listeningQuestions.audio: Never underestimate the power of a kind action.
opts: 永远不要低估善举的力量。
永远不要相信陌生人的话。
力量来自财富而非善意。

listeningQuestions.audio: We often forget to thank the friends who matter most.
opts: 我们常常忘了感谢最重要的朋友。
我们总记得感谢每一个人。
最重要的朋友从不需要感谢。

listeningQuestions.audio: Behrman painted the last leaf and saved his friend's life.
opts: 贝尔曼画了最后一片叶子,救了朋友的命。
贝尔曼摘下最后一片叶子卖钱。
最后一片叶子是真的没有掉。

quizQuestions.q: "cherish a friendship" 中 cherish 意为?
"a small gesture" 中 gesture 意为?
When I walked in, Kyle seemed ____ all his books across the yard.
I'm so glad ____ such a loyal friend years ago.
Tom looks upset; something needs ____ to cheer him up.
The last leaf is believed ____ by Behrman that night.
听句子选中文:A friend in need is a friend indeed.
quizQuestions.audio: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:Good friends help you through your tough moments.
opts: 好朋友帮你度过艰难时刻。
quizQuestions.audio: Good friends help you through your tough moments.

reading.passage: A new boy sat alone at lunch, looking nervous and sad. A classmate simply smiled and said, "Come and sit with us." That small act of kindness was the start of a friendship that lasted for years.
reading.passageCn: 一个新来的男孩独自坐着吃午饭,看上去紧张又难过。一位同学只是微笑着说:"过来和我们一起坐吧。"那个小小的善举,成了一段持续多年的友谊的开端。

questions.q: How did the new boy feel at lunch?

writing.prompt: Write a few sentences to thank a friend who once helped you. Mention what they did and why you are grateful.
writing.promptCn: 写几句话感谢一位曾经帮过你的朋友:说说他/她做了什么,以及你为什么心怀感激。

lines.text: There's a new student in our class today. She looks a bit lonely.
lines.cn: 今天班里来了个新同学,她看起来有点孤单。

lines.text: Let's go and say hello. A friendly smile can really help.
lines.cn: 我们去打个招呼吧,一个友好的微笑真的很有用。

lines.text: Good idea. I'll save her a seat and show her around at lunch.
lines.cn: 好主意,我给她留个座位,午饭时带她转转。

lines.text: Perfect. One small gesture might make her whole week.
lines.cn: 太好了,一个小举动也许能温暖她一整周。
